dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #Oh, hey there, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It's so good to see you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I like it a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I'm not too fussy about where I stay. After all, as an Outrider, I have to be able to adapt to all kinds of surroundings.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: If I had to, I could even sleep on a tree branch.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Y—You really think so...?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Anyway, don't worry, this place is great!

choices.text: I hope you're more comfortable here than on a tree branch.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hahaha, of course I am!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Sure!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm no good at telling stories. Not like Lisa or my grandfather... They seem to be able to fit a thrilling tale into every conversation.

choices.text: Haven't you been keeping a journal—

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Huh!? How long have you known about that!?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: N—Not that I've been hiding it from anyone, it's just that... well, you'd be flattered to read some of the entries...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: ...But it's still a bit embarrassing to just let someone else read my journal!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hmm... I guess I could pick out some excerpts from my adventures if you're interested.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Okay! Where do I start...

choices.text: I'd like to hear more about your past.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: My past...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Uh... I think you might find it a little boring. Besides, in hindsight, let's just say that little Amber was... a bit of a nuisance.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I mean, if you really wanna know, I'm happy to tell you about it... but only if you promise you won't laugh at me!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sounds good to me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Let's have dinner together!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It doesn't need to be anything sophisticated. I just want to enjoy the feeling of having a meal at home. It's quite different from eating out.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Restaurants are convenient and all, and you can always trust that the food's gonna be good.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: But you only get that special cozy feeling when you're eating at home, you know?

choices.text: Yeah, I know what you mean.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Great! Then what are we waiting for?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Right, we'll do some steak, and— Oh, wait... you must have had my Outrider's Champion Steak a million times already.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: You know what, it's high time I set myself a new culinary challenge.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: ...Ooh, and I know just the dish — today, I'll try my hand at a Sticky Honey Roast!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Uh... But what if the smoke changes the color of your ceiling...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I was thinking of painting it a new color anyway.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't worry, I can help with the cooking.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hehe, you're so kind to me.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Get ready for the most delicious meal you've ever eaten! ...Even if it takes me a few hundred times.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I can't wait...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Really!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Amber.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Don't forget, if you ever need an Outrider, just come find me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Amber.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Good night! Don't stay up too late!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You built such a spacious campsite — amazing...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Can I practice my archery and scouting techniques here?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Or maybe we can practice together! Let's compete and see who wins!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Newcomers who are learning how to use wind gliders will practice simple exercises in Springvale.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Most of the buildings in Springvale only have two or three floors, which is an ideal height for those still getting accustomed to gliding.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: However, please remember to glide legally! The rules also apply here.
